title: Example 286's fixed protected-state task at the frozen bound 8 now that the binding error's message is modelled: where it stops, and a trial over ASCII names
description: The state stream of the domain-advances brief, step 3. Binding "32" to someMap records a binding error whose default message is the exception's getLocalizedMessage(), which Spring's NestedRuntimeException.getMessage builds from Throwable's message and the cause's toString(). The own checker now keeps a JDK exception's message and cause from the constructor that set them (lib/src/bmc/throwables.rs: getMessage, getCause, getLocalizedMessage, toString, getClass(), StringBuilder(int) and append(Object)), counts a JDK exception's constructor as exact only where its bytecode just passes its arguments up to Throwable's (two false proofs closed, tested in lib/tests/claims.rs an_exceptions_message_and_cause_are_kept_from_the_jdks_constructor), and its concatenation cap is 256 code units instead of 64. Step 1 runs the frozen claim examples/286-spring-framework-cve-2022-22968-case-sensitive-disallowed-fields/claims/protected-age-not-mutated.json, unchanged, on 5.3.19 through proofs/prove.py at its own bound 8 (job 20261117-192205 stopped it at two gaps, LinkedHashSet.<init>() since modelled and non-ASCII toLowerCase()); a capped probe of the whole domain at bound 8 did not finish in 5 minutes. Step 2 is a trial, not the claim: the same run with --assume-also restricting field to ASCII (the corrected formalization the stream will propose), which a capped probe proved at bound 7 in 108 s, resting on the stand-ins (sampled), the models, ClassUtils and PropertyEditorRegistrySupport observed, the locale assumption and the simpleMatch lemma. Each step writes to a work folder of its own, apart from verification/.work-286/state-stand-in, whose files the accepted refutation reads.
expected: step 1 exits 1 with 'verdict: unverifiable' naming the one gap java.lang.String.toLowerCase() at DataBinder.isAllowed:828 (any other gap is a finding to record); step 2 exits 0 with 'verdict: verified (expected verified)' at bound 8 and the trial line
